kitDescription: Viper is a Water SG attacker whose identity is Burst-II re-entry: when she uses her burst, the chain re-opens Burst Stage 2 so a second Burst-II ally also casts in the same rotation. At battle start she gives the whole team a 10-second ATK and Hit Rate window. On entering Full Burst she gains Vamp status (untargetable, with 1s of invulnerability), and while attacking in Vamp she builds self-stacking Sustained Damage and Hit Rate buffs up to 10 stacks. Her burst deals a 1029.6% hit to one enemy, lowers the stage target's DEF for 10s, and applies a 105.3%-per-second sustained damage-over-time for 10s — the DoT being what her Sustained Damage stacks amplify. She also carries a permanent self Hit Rate passive.

redAssertions: (1) 'Vamp persists AFTER the FB window closes' — blind asserts between-FB stack accrual; driver uses fbGate:'inFb'. Classified: DOCUMENTED_GAP (⚑1, reconciled; no permanent-after-first-FB primitive exists, S4 forbids engine change, load-bearing sustained-DoT coupling fully captured, residual <~1%).

(2) 'DEF 19.83% is a BOSS-held debuff' + (3) 'DEF debuff lifts the WHOLE team' — blind models DEF▼ as load-bearing; driver holds it inert/unmodeled. Classified: RECON_ERROR against the blind on ground truth (sim.ts:1719 cfg.bossDef is a fixed constant with no debuff channel — unenactable; SSOT magnitude ~0.01%; phantom/guilty/marciana precedent).

(4,5) S1b/S2a 'removing them ... moves NO teammate' — the damage-cost half PASSES (driver probe: -5.2% / -7.2% viper total); only the blind's relDiff<1e-9 byte-identical-teammate tolerance fails on a ~0.07% multi-unit coupling artifact. Classified: RECON_ERROR (blind over-strictness; driver scopes both lines self correctly).

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA found: every blind-vs-driver divergence is either a reconciled DOCUMENTED_GAP or a blind-side RECON_ERROR. The blind S6 override converges on the driver's full encoding set byte-for-byte on every load-bearing line (battle-start team window, fbGate-gated self stacks, continuous self HR, burstCast reenterStage 2, treasure-value 1029.6 nuke, sustained 105.3 DoT) — the only diff is the cosmetic inert-encoding style of DEF▼19.83% (both agree it is inert; neither uses damageTakenPct). The two contested dispositions resolve to the driver on ground truth: DEF▼ is unenactable (sim.ts:1719, no enemy-DEF debuff channel) and negligible (~0.01%, SSOT) with phantom/guilty/marciana precedent, and fbGate:'inFb' is the closest available Vamp primitive with the load-bearing sustained-DoT coupling fully captured and the <~1% between-FB hit-rate residual declared as ⚑1 with a recipe. Driver tests discriminate (462.85 base-nuke counterfactual, gate-removed stacker, re-entry removal all fail as named); the driver's crown fixture correctly exposes the re-entry the blind's raw fixture vacuated (blind artifact, fixed in the adapted run where 15/20 pass and 0 of 5 fails indicate driver infidelity). Same-model residual the owner should spot-check: (a) the pellets-vs-pulls accrual convention for the S1b stacks (unflagged by the driver, flagged by S6; behaviorally moot since the cap binds inside the window either way, but the ramp profile is cadence-derived ⚑3); (b) S2b's 'DoT crit default OFF' remark contradicts the SSOT DOT_CRIT-on default — the shipped encoding follows the SSOT, but the convergence record's prose is wrong on that point; (c) all three agents share the same 'stage target appears = one t=0 application' read, a stable-but-unmeasured convention.
